parts.text: I am Alex Chen (alex.chen@example.com), a junior in TX on an H-4 visa planning to study Computer Science with a $50k annual budget. Check my non-citizen aid policy and 2027-2028 Common App deadlines.

H-4 dependent visa holders are not eligible for federal aid (FAFSA) and should use CSS Profile/ISFAA, target merit-generous Tier 3 universities, and verify Texas in-state tuition eligibility with the registrar. Note the August 1, 2027 Common App rollover, November 1 EA/merit deadlines, 72-hour portal TOEFL waiver verification, and May 1, 2028 National College Decision Day. Verification Notice: Verify all figures and eligibility rules directly with the university's Admissions/Financial Aid Office, Designated School Official (DSO), or a qualified immigration attorney.
